scenario: Pluriactividad in the first year of a new activity: G11's salary of 40,000 (employee SS 2,600) plus an activity started in January 2025, invoicing 30,000 to foreign clients, VC. No economic activity was carried on in 2024, none of the clients paid the taxpayer a salary in 2024, and the only expense is twelve months of the RETA tarifa plana at 80 € (960). This is the activity's first period with a positive net, so the LIRPF art. 32.3 reduction takes 20 % off it in the annual return. The Modelo 130 advances are computed on the unreduced net, with the minoración of a taxpayer who had no activity the year before.

modelo130.oracleRef: Arithmetic under SPEC-003 §1, RD 439/2007 (RIRPF) art. 30.2ª and 110.1.a (boe.es consolidated text of BOE-A-2007-6820, read 2026-09-26) and AEAT, instrucciones del modelo 130 (sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, page updated 11 Sep 2026, read 2026-09-26), casillas 02–19: casilla 02 includes difícil justificación of 5 % of the net to date, which stays below the 2,000 cap (5 % × 29,040 = 1,452), and casilla 03 applies only art. 32.1 before it, never art. 32.3. So 0.20 of a cumulative net growing by 7,260 − 363 = 6,897 a quarter. No activity in 2024 counts as a previous-year net of zero, which is in the 9,000 band of RD 439/2007 art. 110.3.c: a minoración of 100 each quarter. Σ 130 is 0.20 × 27,588 − 400 = 5,117.60 (#33).
